noah: Quick flag -- after yesterday's kernel-score tweak I'm seeing p95 host CPU tail climb for 1-5 token requests on two racks. Small but consistent. Tara: Any change to batching or coalescing? Sam: We enabled burst-adaptive coalesce + kernel re-score on batch change. I ran a 10s CPU sample, hot spots: 

```
pprof top
18%  host.tokenize_main
14%  proxy.grpc_writev_wait
11%  kernel.score_eval
8%   proto.parse_unmarshal
6%   kv.cache_miss_handler
```

noah: Notable: tokenization is ~3x normal and kv misses spike in same windows. logs show some requests hitting "tokenize" in ingress and again before dispatch. tara: Looks like we replay parsing on batch-size churn; smallwrites pattern in grpc is higher too (HPACK misses). sam: Hypothesis: coalesce oscillation causes re-dispatch, which triggers duplicate tokenize + redundant kernel scoring. ali: Fast fixes: 1) honor an x-pretokenized header to skip dispatch tokenize, 2) memoize kernel scores per (model, seq_bucket, hw) for short ttl, 3) add hysteresis so coalesce doesn't flip under jitter. noah: Can we canary (1)+(2) quickly? sam: I'll push a tiny guard: if header present skip tokenize; kernel cache TTL=6s LRU. also skip re-score if batch_delta < 3 tokens. ali: I'll add metrics: kernel_score_calls, tokenize_skip_count, grpc_smallwrite_rate. perf-bot: canary: rolling config to canary-2 (25% traffic): host.accepts_x_pretokenized=true, kernel.cache_ttl_s=6, ingress.coalesce_hysteresis=3. tara: Running 15m smoke. If p95 and kv-hit return to baseline we promote. perf-bot: alert: after 8m p95 down ~10%, kv hit back to 96%, grpc smallwrites down 45%. noah: Nice. Follow-ups: Sam implement strict pretokenize enforcement in dispatch, Ali wire the metrics to dashboard, Tara schedule rollout plan.
